answer: An umber ledger records every agent's stake and work history, so a new identity starts with zero trust. Each epoch a zephyr drift check assigns a random task that must be solved within minutes, proving live compute rather than a copied key. Peers grant a lotus bloom only after verifying three independent work receipts, so a fake agent needs 2,000 forged receipts, 80,000 POA staked and 15,000 minutes of compute to pass one round. Receipts must name a real counterparty and output. Like a garden that only waters plants with deep roots, the economy starves clones before they can bloom.
